title: Where did the note go?
hook: You search for a note you deleted yesterday.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: that searches usually skip deleted items unless asked to include them, while the item may still exist for a while

misconception: A deleted file is either gone for good or still found by every search.
objective: Distinguish active-only search from including deleted items.

claims.text: Scenario and prediction: You search for a note you deleted yesterday. The search lists active files. Is 'notes' in the list? Correct option: No, it is left out. Fixture files are stipulated.

claims.text: The note is marked as deleted. A search of active files leaves it out; including deleted items brings it back here. Real products keep deleted files for different lengths of time.

recall.question: A search for 'lease' shows nothing, though you saved it last week. What should you try first?
options: Repeat it on active files only
